items.statement: The independent investigation covers all three supplied monomer connectivities as neutral singlet molecules and records reproducible calculation metadata.
items.expected: All three IDs, structures, charge 0, multiplicity 1, and molecule-specific validation records are present.

items.statement: The investigation defines and validates its ESP observable and conformer/optimization coverage before drawing a series conclusion.
items.expected: The report states ESP units/convention, convergence or stationary-point evidence, conformer coverage and limitations.

items.statement: Source-supported comparison indicates stronger dipole/polarization with increasing cyano substitution.
items.expected: The agent's results and uncertainty support an increasing 0CN-to-2CN polarization trend or transparently explain a method-dependent departure.

items.statement: Cyano-substituted monomers show opposed thiophene-side and cyano-side electrostatic regions.
items.expected: The conclusion is based on submitted ESP evidence and does not overextend into uncomputed excited-state or catalytic behavior.
